verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is itself a documented public API. The docs cover synchronous Fast mode, a WebSocket Live mode, Batch jobs over S3 prefixes, and REST CRUD endpoints for vocabulary assets. They also document programmatic auth with scoped credentials, expiry and short-lived JWTs, and probes confirm the developer docs are publicly reachable as machine-readable markdown with an llms.txt index. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actual API calls succeeding (probes only fetched documentation pages).
